title: 2.7.28 Video — Wrap and Capstone Preview
description: You've built every piece — mouse input, joints, forces, two-player games, state machines, saves. This short video closes Unit 2.7 and previews what Unit 2.8 asks you to do: design and pitch your own game from scratch.
